snippet.title: Serre Trailer
snippet.description:
A visual novel about a girl and an alien drinking tea and falling in love! 

This game is eight years old. And now. It will finally be available on Steam. On April 15th.

Wishlist here: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3574510/Serre/
